collectionNote: All material facts/market data in this pack refer to information available at or before the 2026-09-22 15:00 Asia/Shanghai cutoff. The pack freezes normalized claims used for the forward research snapshot; later outcomes must not be added here.

reviewItems.title: Smaller phone, laptop makers dig in for years of memory scarcity
reviewItems.normalizedClaim: Device makers are facing acute DRAM scarcity; supplier bargaining power is high and industry participants expect tight memory supply to persist into 2027-2028.

reviewItems.title: Microchip reports first quarter fiscal 2027 financial results
reviewItems.normalizedClaim: Microchip reported sequential and year-on-year sales growth, improving end demand and inventory normalization, with guidance for further sequential growth.

reviewItems.title: Copper hits record as supply constraints meet AI/electrification demand
reviewItems.normalizedClaim: Copper reached record levels around $14,700 per tonne amid mine disruptions and strong electrification/data-center demand.

reviewItems.title: Codelco cuts 2026 copper production target
reviewItems.normalizedClaim: Codelco reduced its 2026 copper production target after operational disruptions and industrial action, reinforcing near-term mine-supply tightness.

reviewItems.title: US imports of Congolese copper rise to record
reviewItems.normalizedClaim: US imports of copper from the DRC reached a record while China's share of Congolese copper exports fell, indicating a broader buyer base and changing trade flows for DRC copper.

reviewItems.title: Chinese MDI/TDI producers announce price increases
reviewItems.normalizedClaim: Major producers announced MDI/TDI price increases, but downstream purchasing remained cautious and the move appeared driven more by cost/supply discipline than broad end-demand acceleration.

reviewItems.title: Physical oil cargoes trade at extreme premiums amid disruptions
reviewItems.normalizedClaim: Physical crude/product markets showed severe short-term tightness and high cargo premiums, but the shock was heavily influenced by logistics/geopolitical disruptions.

reviewItems.title: Power-demand boom spurs gas and nuclear investment
reviewItems.normalizedClaim: Data-center/electrification demand is encouraging new gas and nuclear investment, but the broad AI-power-capex theme is already widely recognized.
